summary: Iteration 2 full-stack regression for Rudralife landing page restructure. Backend 6/6 pytest still passing (root, register happy/422 invalid-email/422 missing-field/optional message default, list registrations ordered). Frontend: all new/updated sections render correctly — split Hero (banner on LEFT with rudraksha visible, no blur, no 'Rudralife' overlay; all text on RIGHT with OM/Empower Yourself/CTAs/stats), 7 Experts with real rudralife.com photos + years badges (Dr. Tanay Seetha first, 25+ Years), Seekers Worldwide (17 celebrity cards × 2 rows duplicated for seamless auto-scroll = 34 elements, seeker-milind-soman & seeker-manoj-bajpayee verified), 4 Video Testimonials (all anchors to YouTube), Media Features (Bombay Times/Republic Bharat/Swastik Production all anchors to youtu.be), 18 media-logo cells (9×2 duplicated for scroll strip), Collection first product is 'siddha-mala' / 'Siddha Mala' / 'For Overall Growth and Success'. Images: 82/92 rudralife.com images loaded on viewport scroll; remaining 10 live in horizontally-scrolling collection carousel and all 5 unique URLs verified 200 OK via curl. End-to-end registration (Hero→Exhibitions→Hyderabad→Register Now→3 steps→success) completed and TEST_ITER2 User persisted via GET /api/registrations. No React runtime errors; no 'Testimonials is not defined' error.

issues: One dev-console hydration warning: '<span> cannot be a child of <option>'. Root cause is the Emergent preview's dynamic-editing instrumentation injecting a <span> inside <option> in RegistrationModal exhibition <select>. Not present in production build and not caused by app code. Cosmetic in dev only.

critical_code_review_comments: Seekers/media logos/collection images carry no explicit width/height attrs — can cause CLS on slow networks. Consider setting fixed height on images or container to stabilise layout.

All major images are hot-linked from rudralife.com. Today they return 200 with no CORS issue (verified via curl + browser), but Rudralife could change hotlink policy or rename files at any time with no warning. Recommend downloading and caching these 92 images locally (public/images/...) for reliability and faster first paint.
No lazy-loading boundary / error fallback on — if a remote rudralife image 404s later the card shows a broken-image icon. Add onError fallback to a local placeholder.
server.py POST /api/register remains public with no rate limiting or captcha — carried over from iteration 1; still a production concern for spam.

RegistrationModal exhibition <select> renders dynamic name inside <option> — the Emergent dev instrumentation wraps it in a <span>, causing the hydration warning. Not fixable in app code (dev-tool only), flagging for awareness.
seed_data_creation: One extra TEST_ITER2 User registration added to registrations collection via end-to-end UI flow (email: test_iter2@example.com, city: Hyderabad). Total now 11 registrations including 4 TEST_ prefixed from both iterations.
